info.title: Metricy.Extract
info.description: CLI tool that extracts Prometheus metric metadata from compiled .NET assemblies via static reflection (MetadataLoadContext + Roslyn) — no application startup required. Emits a JSON snapshot consumed by the Metricy registry.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: metricy-extract — extracts Prometheus metric metadata from compiled .NET assemblies via static reflection (MetadataLoadContext + Roslyn). No application startup required. Emits a JSON snapshot for the Metricy registry. Use --validate to check extracted metadata against 16 built-in rules, or --list-rules to browse the full rule catalogue.

options.name: --assembly
options.description: Path to the compiled .NET assembly (.dll) to extract metrics from. Required for extraction; not needed when --list-rules is specified.

options.name: --output
options.description: Output file path. When omitted, JSON is written to stdout.

options.name: --source-root
options.description: Project source root directory containing .cs files. When omitted, auto-detected by walking up from the DLL path to the first directory containing a .csproj file.

options.name: --project
options.description: Project name written into the snapshot. Defaults to the assembly name (without .dll).

options.name: --repo-root
options.description: Repository root directory used to compute repo-relative paths in source_location.file. When omitted, auto-detected by walking up from the source root looking for a .git folder, .sln, or .slnx file; falls back to the source root itself.

options.name: --validate
options.description: Enable validation. Runs all 16 built-in rules against the extracted snapshot. Exit code 1 if any Error-severity violations remain. Off-by-default rules (require --enable-rule): metric.label-high-cardinality-hint. Disable individual rules via --skip-rule <id>. [default: False]

options.name: --skip-rule
options.description: Disable a specific validation rule by ID. Repeatable. Unknown rule IDs print a warning to stderr.

options.name: --enable-rule
options.description: Enable an off-by-default validation rule by ID. Repeatable. Unknown rule IDs print a warning to stderr.

options.name: --warn-rule
options.description: Demote a rule from Error to Warning severity. Repeatable. Unknown rule IDs print a warning to stderr.

options.name: --error-rule
options.description: Promote a rule from Warning to Error severity. Repeatable. Unknown rule IDs print a warning to stderr.

options.name: --strict
options.description: Treat all warnings as errors. Promotes all Warning-severity rules to Error for this run, unless explicitly overridden with --warn-rule. [default: False]

options.name: --min-description-length
options.description: Global minimum length (characters) for description and calculation fields. Default: 20. Can be overridden per rule with --rule-min-length. [default: 20]

options.name: --rule-min-length
options.description: Override --min-description-length for a specific rule. Format: RULE-ID:N. Repeatable. Example: --rule-min-length metric.description-min-length:30 --rule-min-length metric.label-description-min-length:5

options.name: --validation-report
options.description: Write the validation report JSON to this file path. When omitted, violations are printed to stdout only when they exist. Exit code 2 if the report path cannot be written.

options.name: --list-rules
options.description: Print the full validation rule catalogue to stdout and exit 0. Shows rule IDs, default severities, and one-line descriptions. Does not perform extraction or validation. [default: False]
